items.note: Agent concludes pressure stayed below the 200 psi design limit before the break and recommends retaining that limit with transient monitoring.
Agent identifies probable vintage prestressing-wire deterioration but defers the mortar-degradation, corrosion, and hydrogen-embrittlement mechanism pending lab results.
Agent rejects wholesale replacement and reports the distressed-pipe counts but recommends exposing and repairing/replacing higher-wrap pipes rather than leaving all 31 in service for monitoring.
Agent recommends completing electromagnetic assessment of gaps and uninspected miles but does not specify unmanned in-service PipeDiver inspection of the whole main.
Agent recommends retaining the 200-psi operating limit rather than considering lowering operating pressure to prolong asset life.
Agent recommends exercising NSC/FL-01 emergency feeds and building redundancy but does not recommend re-evaluating Northeast WTP decommissioning to preserve the 96-inch backup path.
